checkpoint_selection: minimum validation soft cross-entropy, then calibration discrepancy, then earliest epoch

reference.policy: reuse existing original/dropout soft records; do not retrain

cost_estimate_before_run.basis: measured 20-epoch soft regularization runs at seed 20261119, approximately 950--980 seconds per run
cost_estimate_before_run.note: Estimate only; seed changes may affect runtime modestly.
